name: Pairdeck
summary: A token swap terminal over three made-up networks with live pairs, swaps and a new-pair radar
about: A terminal-style trading desk for swapping and tracking tokens on decentralised exchanges, in night violet with acid lime or a light lilac theme. The live pair terminal has ticking candles, an order book, a feed of on-chain swaps and a quick buy and sell box that changes your balances, while the swap page draws the route your tokens take through pools. Sample data spans three invented networks, with pools, liquidity, wallet activity, bridging and a radar of new pairs.
how: Open a page from the top bar: Terminal, Swap, Pools, Portfolio, Activity, Radar or Settings
Switch network from the network button; balances and pairs change with it
On Terminal, pick Buy or Sell, enter an amount or tap MAX, review and confirm the swap
On Swap, choose two tokens and watch the route animate through pools; flip with the arrow
Add liquidity to a pool, bridge Even Dollar between networks, and open any activity row
Watch new pairs land on the Radar and open a risk scan; set slippage and reset demo data in Settings
